description: This file defines API routes for a notes management backend, using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, searching, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, with associated request and response models. It also manages database connection dependencies and error handling.

methods.name: NoteResponse _note_to_response(note)
methods.description: Converts a note object from the database to a NoteResponse data model.

methods.name: db_conn_dep()
methods.description: Dependency generator that provides a database connection with schema initialized.

methods.name: HTTPException _map_service_error_to_http(e: Exception)
methods.description: Maps internal exceptions to appropriate HTTPException responses.

methods.name: NoteResponse create_note_route(payload: NoteCreateRequest, conn=Depends(db_conn_dep))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new note.

methods.name: NotesListResponse list_notes_route( limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of notes to return."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset."), conn=Depends(db_conn_dep), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list notes with pagination.

methods.name: NotesSearchResponse search_notes_route( q: str = Query(..., min_length=1, max_length=500, description="Search query."), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of notes to return."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset."), conn=Depends(db_conn_dep), )
methods.description: API endpoint to search notes by query string.

methods.name: NoteResponse get_note_route(note_id: str, conn=Depends(db_conn_dep))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: NoteResponse update_note_route(note_id: str, payload: NoteUpdateRequest, conn=Depends(db_conn_dep))
methods.description: API endpoint to update an existing note.

methods.name: DeleteResponse delete_note_route(note_id: str, conn=Depends(db_conn_dep))
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a note by ID.
